runs.question: Which genre has the longest average track length?
runs.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY AVG(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1
runs.final_sql:
SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS AvgMilliseconds
FROM Genre g
JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
HAVING AVG(t.Milliseconds) = (
  SELECT MAX(avg_ms) FROM (
    SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) AS avg_ms
    FROM Track
    WHERE GenreId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY GenreId
  )
);
runs.answer: The Sci Fi & Fantasy genre has the longest average track length, at about 2,911,783 milliseconds (roughly 48.5 minutes) per track. The result shows only this one row, so it is the single top genre from the query.

runs.question: Which customers have spent more than the average customer?
runs.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId))
runs.final_sql:
WITH spend AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent
  FROM Customer c
  JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
)
SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, total_spent
FROM spend
WHERE total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM spend)
ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
runs.answer: 22 customers spent more than the average customer. The top three are Helena Holý ($49.62), Richard Cunningham ($47.62), and Luis Rojas ($46.62), and the lowest qualifying total is $39.62.

runs.question: For each year, which genre sold the most tracks?
runs.gold_sql: SELECT y, g FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) AS y, gr.Name AS g, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC) AS rk FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre gr ON gr.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY y, gr.GenreId) WHERE rk = 1
runs.final_sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) AS Year,
         g.Name AS Genre,
         SUM(il.Quantity) AS TracksSold
  FROM InvoiceLine il
  JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
  JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
  GROUP BY Year, g.GenreId
)
SELECT Year, Genre, TracksSold
FROM s
WHERE TracksSold = (SELECT MAX(TracksSold) FROM s s2 WHERE s2.Year = s.Year)
ORDER BY Year;
runs.answer: Rock was the best-selling genre in every year from 2009 to 2013. It sold 180 tracks in 2009, dipped to 157 in 2010, and then rose to 176 by 2013.
